items.title: SanDisk Stock Looks Cheap, But Can It Keep Earning This Much?
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK) has returned nearly 1,600% over the past twelve months and still trades at 19.5 times earnings, against an S&P 500 median of 22.4. It sits about 35% below its 52-week high. A cash-generative business priced under the market is where value buyers start. The question is whether those earnings are a new normal or the top of a memory cycle.
